thread:
Marta: Team, prepping Dedicated GPU capacity for our Q2 rollouts. Need quota increases and IP/subnet planning. Can someone open provider tickets today?

Ryan: which regions and instance classes are we targeting?

Marta: Primary: gcp us-west1 for steady pool and bursts. Secondary: eu-west1 for DR and H100s. Goal: steady 24x A100-80GB (multi-GPU nodes), burst to 40 GPUs. Also seed 8x H100s in eu-west1.

Alex: Clarify node topology? single-GPU VMs or multi-GPU nodes?

Marta: Multi-GPU. us-west1 nodes: 4x A100 per node -> 6 nodes steady, burst to 10 nodes. eu-west1 H100s: 2x H100 per node -> 4 nodes.

Jin: Networking: we'll hit ENI/internal IP limits unless we size subnets. Proposing /22 in us-west1 and /23 in eu-west1. Need extra ephemeral external IP quota for NAT scaling.

Alex: Draft quota list for support tickets (GCP):
- GPUs (A100-80GB) us-west1: request quota -> 40
- GPUs (H100) eu-west1: request quota -> 8
- vCPU increase us-west1 -> +384 (match node vCPU needs)
- External ephemeral IPs (regional) us-west1 -> +60
- Reserved IPs / forwarding rules -> +20
- Increase project route limits / routes-per-vpc if flagged

Ryan: Include a short justification: forecast, steady vs burst, SLA/customer impact, and ask for reservation/commit pricing. Finance will want delta and committed options.

Marta: Forecast notes: steady 24 A100s (~10M tokens/day), monthly peak events up to 40 GPUs. Rough on-demand delta ~$220k/mo. We prefer a 12-month reserved capacity if traffic stabilizes. Please ask providers for committed discount guidance.

Alex: GCP support ticket draft (paste into console):
```
Project: redwood-dedicated-prod
Billing account: BA-REDWOOD-007
Request: Increase regional GPU quota and networking limits
Region: us-west1
Resources requested:
  - GPUs (A100-80GB): current 8 -> request 40
  - vCPUs: +384
  - External ephemeral IPs: +60
  - Forwarding rules / reserved IPs: +20
Justification: Production dedicated inference pool with strict SLA. Steady pool 24 GPUs, burst to 40 for customer events. Will evaluate committed use discounts and reservations. Please advise expected lead time and reservation options.
Add: include IAM role updates for autoscaler service account so it can attach GPUs and modify forwarding rules.
```

Jin: Add subnet sizing (/22) and tag networking team. If they ask, include our Terraform module path to speed review.

Alex: Also opening AWS case for eu-west-1 H100 equivalents (p4de family). AWS text sample:
```
Service: Amazon EC2
Limit: GPU instance quota (p4de/p4d families) in eu-west-1
Requested: +8 instances (H100-equivalent)
Justification: Warm nodes for latency-sensitive Redwood Dedicated customers. Will pursue Savings Plans / RIs if usage sustained.
```

Marta: Timeline: Q2 launch in ~6 weeks. Target: quotas approved within 2 weeks. If providers need longer, plan a short-term burst to partner region.

Ryan: I'll sync with procurement & sales for commitment numbers and a PO if finance approves.

Jin: Reminder: also need EC2 ENI limits and per-account network interface quotas increased (AWS) and increase in routes-per-table if we hit cloud provider defaults.

Alex: Added BA-REDWOOD-007 and CC'd Chloe on both tickets. Creating internal RFC and cost model: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-pools/gpu-capacity-plan (draft).

infra-bot: GCP case 123456789 created (https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789) - status: PENDING. AWS case 987654321 created.

Ryan: Good. Alex, flag any provider questions back here.

Marta: Next steps:
- Alex: file GCP + AWS support requests and include billing id (today)
- Ryan: finalize procurement approvals & cost center (48h)
- Jin: reserve subnets (/22 us-west1, /23 eu-west1) and prepare Terraform changes (72h)
- infra-bot: post ticket updates here

Alex: done filing. Tickets include IAM/autoscaler note and subnet plan.

infra-bot: Update: GCP case 123456789 -> UPDATED by Alex at 1752101100. AWS case 987654321 -> UPDATED at 1752101155.

Marta: Thanks. Keep updates short here. If providers ask for any more detailed telemetry or traffic curves, ping me directly.

Ryan: sgtm :thumbsup:

Jin: prepping Terraform module and will open a PR for subnet + route changes.

infra-bot: Final note: mark this thread for follow-ups; we need a gate check before enabling burst.
